主要内容: On March 22, 2017, Broadway Financial Corporation and Wayne-Kent A. Bradshaw, its President and Chief Executive Officer, entered into an employment agreement. The agreement outlines the Executive's role as CEO and board member of the Company and its subsidiary bank. The term of employment is three years, with potential annual extensions at the Board's discretion. The Executive's base salary is $435,000 per year, subject to increases but not decreases. During the TARP Period, the Executive will receive annual bonuses in the form of TARP-compliant long-term restricted stock. After the TARP Period, bonus opportunities will be determined by the Compensation Committee. Equity incentives during the TARP Period are limited to restricted stock bonuses, with additional participation in the Company's ESOP. Post-TARP, equity awards will be determined by the Compensation Committee, with vesting requirements of 33% on the first anniversary and the remainder vesting over 24 months, or in full upon certain events such as death, Disability, or termination without Cause. The agreement also includes provisions for vacation and other benefits.
